sample_unit: patients (model development cohort; external validation N=90)
models_evaluated: Super Learner ensemble (5 machine learning algorithms)

links.outcome: Model error on internal cross-validation versus temporally later external validation cohort
links.effect: Cross-validated RMSE 7.08 (R2 = 0.89) versus external validation RMSE 9.02 (R2 = 0.76), so performance was lower on external data.
links.quote: The Super Learner model achieved a cross-validated RMSE of 7.08 (R2 = 0.89) and an external validation RMSE of 9.02 (R2 = 0.76).

unlisted_practices: Validating a microfluidic KASP genotyping chip against Sanger sequencing (100% concordance across 13 SNPs in 24 samples)
Random forest recursive feature elimination for feature selection
Rapid sample-to-report clinical decision support integrating pharmacogenomics (within 3 h)

screen.reason: The study develops and externally validates a machine learning Super Learner ensemble model alongside a microfluidic genotyping chip for predicting antipsychotic response, but does not evaluate a specific deployment practice or safeguard.
